title: windows-explorer-native-integration

tests.scope: Original Explorer scope: four isolated loader cases passed; one desktop availability scenario failed. Repository regressions and the separately recorded windows_image_checkpoint are not added to this original count. Explorer G1 was not retried.

risks: No usable Explorer client or installer; root activation cause remains undetermined.
Direct loading success is not target Explorer loader evidence.
Bounded event query and three mitigation policies do not cover every system restriction.
blocked_by: Session 2 is WTSDisconnected; native computer-use input returned GetCursorPos 0x80070005 and no targetable Explorer window.
Actual Explorer loader/COM observation and G1 remain missing; queried package/AppContainer and explicit Shell policies did not establish a root cause.
G2/G3/G4 and bounded Host-to-Shell projection remain unimplemented/unproven.
Windows image startup cleanup/recovery and complete file/network/COM/handle/resource/cancellation evidence remain pending; guard success alone does not enable the feature.
